prior_year_events.event_name: Favorable claims development on 2009-2016 closed years
prior_year_events.impact_description: There were improvements on our closed years (2009-2016), and these years produced a surplus of US$9.2 million (net figure).

The 2017 year of account was significantly affected by Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, as well as the two Mexican earthquakes with net ultimate claims of $41.8 million across these events (net figure).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross strengthening of $13.040 million for prior accident years up to 2017, as calculated from the claims development triangle. This was driven by adverse development on more recent prior years (2016 and 2017), which were significantly impacted by natural catastrophe events such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and Mexican earthquakes in 2017, and Hurricanes Florence and Michael in 2018. However, the syndicate also noted improvements on older closed years (2009-2016).
